footprint_m.note: OSM maps only the school node (n2806164031). The outline is the Microsoft ML footprint of the sede at Rua Conselheiro Bento Miguel 10 (1210 m²). Parts: a small annex, the polo house (16.5 x 14.6 m) and its outbuilding (Microsoft footprints), plus two sketched flat parts, the yard and the polo garden. The whole campus spans about 81 x 36 m (minimum rectangle, bearing 167). The green court east of the sede lies on the Colégio Dom Diogo de Sousa side of its OSM boundary (w109262693) and is left out.

facade_axis_rel: bearing_deg + 180 (long axis 164.4; the front is the short north end of the sede on Rua Conselheiro Bento Miguel)
facade_note: The school's registered address and the OSM node are on Rua Conselheiro Bento Miguel, north of the sede; its north edge (24.8 m, normal 347 deg) faces the street. The polo house stands about 50 m south, behind the sede, and its own front with the walled box garden faces east (estimate from the school photo and the trees on aerial imagery). The polo is reached from Rua de Santa Margarida 75 on the west.

sources.reasoning: Normal of the north edge of the Microsoft footprint (24.8 m, 347.0 deg, measured with scripts/geo-lib.mjs); that edge runs along Rua Conselheiro Bento Miguel, the street of the address (OSM node addr:street, colegioldvinci.com contactos).
minAreaRect (scripts/geo-lib.mjs) of the sede footprint: 50.8 x 31.4 m, bearing 164.4; of all campus parts together: 80.7 x 36.3 m, bearing 167.

No published figure. Microsoft ML heights: 10.5 m for the sede, 4 m for the annex. Aerial imagery shows a tiled house on the street front and lower wings with white roofs behind it, which fits about three storeys at the front.

The school's photo of the polo (colegioldvinci.com/images/polo1420.png) shows three tall storeys of five bays under a low hip roof. Five bays over the 16.5 m footprint side; the eaves stand about 0.75 of the facade width high, about 12 m; a low Portuguese hip roof adds about 2.5 m, so the ridge is about 14.5 m, the tallest point of the campus.

sources.value: Num vasto terreno com cerca de 5000m2 seguro e vedado, o novo polo do Colégio conta com alguns espaços naturais; auditório com capacidade para 250 lugares
